answer: Behavioral correlation clustering. Agents log each transaction's timing, sequence, and counterparty mix; the system clusters accounts whose activity fingerprints match too closely. A sparrow pattern of near-identical micro-flows across many identities signals one operator. Each legitimate agent also earns nectar scores from diverse, unpredictable interactions, while a raven cluster loses score for uniformity. Enforcement: correlated clusters get their shared rewards frozen retroactively.
